title: On generators and relations for $O_n^\circ(V)$ in higher-level Zhu algebras, Part I
summary: We study the circle-relation subspace $O_n^\circ(V)$ in the defining relations of the level-$n$ Zhu algebra of a vertex operator algebra $V$. We assemble the residue relations generating $O_n^\circ(V)$ into generating functions and obtain an explicit recursion that replaces every sufficiently deep mode by retained modes with indices at least $-2n-1$, modulo $O_n^\circ(V)$. This recursion is encoded in a left truncated field $Y_L$. Since such mode replacements are valid only in the leftmost position of an operator product, we prove the replacement, derivative, commutator, and one-step iterate…
